title: UOS agent user policy
description: The user-adjustable policy of the AI control layer (section 5.3). The user can make the assistant stricter, and can relax the handling of classes 1 and 2 for a named application. Nothing in this file can relax class 3 or class 4. The loader in services/uos-agent is authoritative. It also enforces one rule this schema cannot express: an application has at most one relaxation.

application.description: An application identifier: 1 to 255 characters, no control characters, no surrounding whitespace.

mode.description: normal: the rules of the design, unchanged. ask_every_action: ask before every action of every class; an unattended task is deferred. observe_only: only class 0 actions are available.

excluded_applications.description: Applications the assistant must neither observe nor act in. Matched without regard to ASCII case.

sensitive_applications.description: Applications in which every accessibility and screen action, observation included, is treated as class 2 at least. Matched without regard to ASCII case. Overrides a relaxation.

relaxations.description: Per-application relaxations. Each applies to accessibility and screen actions in that application only, in normal mode, while the user is present.

class.description: The highest class the relaxation covers. 2: consequential actions in the application run without asking. 1: accepted, and changes no decision, because class 1 is already allowed in normal mode and the stricter modes override every relaxation.
